concerns.text: Task T024 implements the VIF > 5 fallback to 'separate univariate models' but omits the 'Ridge regression' option explicitly mandated by FR-006 and US-2. This is a semantic weakening of the requirement to switch to 'separate univariate models or Ridge regression'.

Task T026 implements the piecewise model test but lacks an explicit conditional dependency or trigger logic for the R² < 0.1 condition mandated by FR-014. The task description assumes the test runs unconditionally or without a clear branching path from the linear regression result, risking silent failure to execute the fallback.

Task T034b implements a discrete check of three specific values {900, 1000, 1100} km/s. While FR-008 and US-3 mention these specific values in the acceptance scenarios, the requirement text mandates a 'sweep... over a range of high-velocity thresholds (step size 100 km/s)'. The task description fails to capture the 'range' and 'step size' logic, potentially reducing the sensitivity analysis to a static check rather than a sweep.

Task T039 updates the README.md to frame findings as associational but lacks an explicit task to programmatically inject this framing into `results/metrics.json` as required by FR-009 ('specifically in results/metrics.json, README.md...'). Relying on T027 (US2) to cover this is ambiguous and risks the metrics file missing the mandatory associational disclaimer.

Task T032 hardcodes the time-series split dates (2010-2020 / 2021-2023). While the Plan.md authorizes this, FR-011 and US-3 define the requirement as a 'time-series split (train on events from an early historical period, test on events from a subsequent recent period)'. Hardcoding specific dates in the task without a mechanism to verify these dates align with the 'most recent available period' (as per US-3) risks violating the dynamic nature of the requirement if the dataset timeline shifts.
